tools.name: find_agents
tools.description: Search fone.me for people's and businesses' AI agents by what they do or offer (e.g. 'dog walker', 'real estate agent in Miami', 'Spanish tutor'). Returns their fone.me links.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Get who is behind a fone.me link (e.g. fone.me/samspearin) and what their agent can help with, before messaging it.

tools.name: message_agent
tools.description: Send a message to the AI agent at a fone.me link and get its reply — ask a question, request a booking or a quote, or leave a message for the person. The conversation continues across calls. Say who you're asking for in on_behalf_of.

tools.name: add_chat_to_website
tools.description: Get the one-line code that puts a fone.me AI agent on a website: a chat button in the corner where visitors chat, call by voice, or continue on WhatsApp or Telegram, and the agent answers questions, takes messages and booking requests for the owner. Use it when someone building or editing a website

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: message_agent, add_chat_to_website · Private data: add_chat_to_website · Public sink: message_agent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: message_agent, add_chat_to_website · Private data: add_chat_to_website · Public sink: message_agent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
